alerts.title: Abdominal Pain on DTG
alerts.message: Guidelines list abdominal pain as a symptom to screen for, with DTG noted as a potential cause. The patient reports abdominal pain but has no fever and an okay appetite. DTG is part of the current regimen. Non-drug causes for abdominal pain should also be considered.

evidence.recommended_action: Screen for other DTG-related symptoms and consider non-drug causes. Document as a suspected ADR per guidelines.

alerts.title: ADR Reporting Required
alerts.message: Guidelines mandate that all healthcare workers screen for and report all suspected adverse drug reactions (ADRs) during each encounter. The patient's new abdominal pain while on DTG is a suspected ADR. This should be recorded in HMIS tools and reported.

evidence.recommended_action: Complete the Drug Safety Screening checklist and report the suspected ADR via the appropriate HMIS form or alternative method.
